label: cdp:st:C.2.UN.7
cause: The original Step1 begins with a leavevmode paragraph/spacing prefix. The heading scanner formerly kept leavevmode as a separate first-level claim.
exact_repair: Include leavevmode in the recognized presentation prefix of the authored heading, so the existing Step1 token supplies that same heading item. Deleting list-format tokens gives the exact original mathematical token stream. The proof-level paragraph boundary is retained before the list; its inherited leavevmode/par copy immediately inside an item is removed. The existing mathematical-token projection checks this exact formatting deletion.
